Organizational Entity StatusentityStatushttp://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/hl7-organizational-entity-concept-properties#statusstringThe status of the HL7 Affiliate organizational entity. Values are 'active' and 'inactive'
HL7 Affiliate concept propertyaffiliatehttp://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/hl7-organizational-entity-concept-properties#affiliatecodeThe HL7 Affiliate a group is associated with. Note, the property must not be included in concepts representing actual affiliates
Statusstatushttp://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#statuscodeDesignation of a concept's state. Normally this property is not provided unless its the value is retired. Note, concepts are usually only retired if entered in error. Retirement status should not be interpreted to mean that the group itself was retired.
HL7 JIRA Work Group EntryjiraSpecItemhttp://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/hl7-jira-spec-work-group-concept-properties#work-group-entrybooleanWhether the group is included in the JIRA Spec Artefact file for workgroups
HL7 JIRA Work Group KeyjiraKeyhttp://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/hl7-jira-spec-work-group-concept-properties#keystringThe key stored in the JIRA project. This should not change or be removed even if a work group is renamed or dissolved.
HL7 JIRA Work Group WebcodejiraWebcodehttp://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/hl7-jira-spec-work-group-concept-properties#webcodestringThe code used for the work group on the HL7 website.
HL7 JIRA Work Group deprecatedjiraDeprecatedhttp://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/hl7-jira-spec-work-group-concept-properties#deprecatedbooleanThis is set to true for groups that can no longer be assigned responsibility for tracker items, but which may have had responsibility for historical items
HL7 JIRA Work Group listservjiraListservhttp://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/hl7-jira-spec-work-group-concept-properties#listservstringThe email address used for the work group on the HL7 website.
